capabilities: Intercept the core "New tab" command from the palette and ribbon plus button
Capture the configured "New tab" hotkey via a document-level keydown listener
Insert the new leaf next to the active tab using Workspace.createLeafInParent
Fall back to creating the tab at the end and repositioning it if the public API fails
Log which interception path handled each new tab when debug logging is enabled
extras: Manual installation only (copy manifest.json and main.js into .obsidian/plugins/); the fallback reposition path relies on undocumented internals and may break after major Obsidian UI rewrites.
intentEvidence: Rather than building an independent new-tab feature with its own hotkey, this hooks the single command Obsidian already uses
problem: Obsidian always opens new tabs at the end of the tab strip, with no setting to place them beside the tab you are working in.
summary: Tab-placement plugin that makes new tabs open directly next to the active tab instead of at the end of the tab strip.
